::: {.callout-note}
## Source inspected
The public PDF was read on 20 September 2026. It is a 2015 training presentation, not a 1990s ministry record. It is one side of the 1993-versus-1994 starting-year conflict.
:::

## Annotation

Under “How CSIL Evolved” the deck states: “Established by the Ministry of Health in British Columbia in **1994**, with people with disabilities in the forefront of the program design.” Gauthier is also labelled “the founder of the CSIL program.”

Compare the May 2014 SCI series deck, which uses **1993** in a nearly identical sentence. This archive keeps both dates visible and does not choose between them.

The rest of the deck is a how-to introduction (phases, supported lifestyle plan). It is catalogued here mainly for the dated founding claim.
